caption:
There is a quieter way to spend a day in Morro de São Paulo.

The Fonte do Céu Experience is a slow guided walk through the Atlantic Forest, with a stop at Fonte do Céu and a natural clay ritual by the sea. A shared small-group experience, with up to 8 guests.

Ask us about the Fonte do Céu Experience and we'll help you plan it with our local team.
